About the Burt Corner Sofa

The Burt corner sofa by Fiera Collection combines generous proportions with refined contemporary Italian design, offering a modular seating solution upholstered in premium fabric or full-grain leather. Deep cushioning and a sturdy timber frame ensure lasting comfort and structural integrity, while clean linear silhouettes lend a sophisticated aesthetic. Customisable configurations allow the corner sofa to adapt to varied living room layouts and open-plan spaces. Suited to modern residential interiors and luxury hospitality lounges seeking understated elegance and versatile functionality.
